title: Documentation page: rental API
content:
Developer docs: "Checking rental availability" (part of the Rental API guide).

Sidebar navigation: Getting started, Authentication, Checking availability (current page), Creating a booking, Errors.
On this page: Request, Response, Errors.

Content:
To check whether an item is free, send a GET request to /v1/items/{id}/availability with start and end dates.

Request example:
GET /v1/items/kayak-tidewater/availability?start=2026-11-08&end=2026-11-09
Authorization: Bearer <token>

Response example:
{ "available": true, "units": 3 }

Parameters: start (date, required), end (date, required), units (integer, optional, default 1).
Errors: 404 if the item doesn't exist; 422 if end is before start.
Next page: Creating a booking.
